scope: Two experimentally characterized plant enzymes with different reported major products from GPP; a descriptive case study, not a classifier or causal sequence-to-product model.
comparison_limits: The pair comes from different species and differs in sequence length and targeting annotations. A full-sequence alignment describes similarity but does not isolate product-determining residues.
Each evidence statement retains its source and scope. Reviewed database status is separate from experimental support for an individual field.
The project includes an experimental structure only for the orange enzyme. It cannot compare both experimental pockets.
Reaction strings copied from UniProt use database protonation conventions; the chemical module separately documents its neutral compound representations.

enzymes.name: (R)-limonene synthase 1, chloroplastic
enzymes.sequence_numbering: One-based, inclusive positions in the full canonical UniProt sequence, including any annotated targeting sequence.

annotated_motifs.name: DDXXD motif
annotated_motifs.interpretation: UniProt annotation in canonical residue numbering; this conserved motif alone does not predict product identity.

product_specificity.scope: Reported products in the GPP assay of Morehouse et al. (2017), not a universal product-yield prediction.
product_specificity.enantiomer_note: The limonene product was exclusively the (+) enantiomer; this does not mean limonene was the only reaction product. Alpha-pinene stereochemistry is not assigned here.
product_specificity.class_fraction_note: The cyclic-product class totals 99.3% when alpha-pinene is included; that is distinct from the reported 99% limonene fraction.
product_specificity.substrate_scope_note: This project selects the GPP reaction. UniProt also annotates activity with neryl diphosphate from PMID28272876; the selected enzyme is not claimed to accept only GPP.

evidence.label: Morehouse et al. (2017): product assay and experimental structure
evidence.text: Recombinant Citrus sinensis enzyme produces predominantly (+)-limonene from GPP, with minor myrcene and alpha-pinene. The paper reports an open apo structure at 2.3 Å.

evidence.label: UniProt A0A1C9J6A7: reviewed sequence and field-specific annotations
evidence.text: The pinned reviewed entry supplies the 607-residue canonical precursor sequence. Review status does not make every annotation experimentally measured.

evidence.label: RCSB PDB 5UV0: experimental coordinates
evidence.text: Chain A is a single experimental apo model with 522 modeled residues; it contains no modeled substrate, product or metal.

publications.title: Functional and Structural Characterization of a (+)-Limonene Synthase from Citrus sinensis.
publications.access_used: PubMed abstract and PMC full text.

sequence_mapping.provenance: RCSB SIFTS alignment and explicit comparison of the pinned entity and UniProt sequences.

construct.reported_tag: N-terminal His6 tag replaces the plastid targeting segment.
construct.note: The deposited polymer reference sequence is 607 residues, whereas the experimental construct was truncated and tagged. The 85 unmodeled reference positions include the removed targeting segment; they are not all experimental disorder.

historical_sequence_conflict.source: _struct_ref_seq_dif in the pinned mmCIF retains an ALA/VAL conflict; RCSB reports one conflict and zero mutations.
historical_sequence_conflict.interpretation: The current pinned UniProt sequence (version 2) and PDB entity sequence agree at this position. Preserve the historical annotation without treating it as a current sequence mismatch or engineered mutation.

interpretation_limits: This open apo model does not show a substrate pose or a catalytic intermediate.
The paper notes unassigned active-site density; no substrate or product is assigned to it here.
One available enzyme structure cannot support a two-enzyme pocket comparison or structural RMSD.

annotation_limits: The transit-peptide boundary and DDXXD motif carry curator-inference evidence ECO:0000305 in UniProt.
Metal-binding annotations from other cited experiments are not evidence for modeled metals in the selected apo 5UV0 structure.

enzymes.name: R-linalool synthase
enzymes.sequence_numbering: One-based, inclusive positions in the full canonical UniProt sequence, including any annotated targeting sequence.

annotated_motifs.name: DDXXD motif
annotated_motifs.interpretation: UniProt annotation in canonical residue numbering; this conserved motif alone does not predict product identity.

product_specificity.scope: LaLINS product identity reported by Landmann et al. (2007); abstract and reviewed UniProt annotations were inspected.
product_specificity.reported_specificity: The paper abstract reports exclusively (R)-(−)-linalool from LaLINS.
product_specificity.interpretation: This is the authors' reported product specificity under their assay conditions, not a universal purity or yield guarantee. No quantitative product table is reconstructed from the abstract.
product_specificity.identity_note: LaLINS is the selected linalool synthase. The same paper also describes a different enzyme, LaLIMS, with a mixed limonene product profile.

evidence.label: Landmann et al. (2007): experimentally characterized LaLINS
evidence.text: The paper abstract reports that recombinant lavender LaLINS produces exclusively (R)-(−)-linalool. This project inspected the abstract and UniProt annotation, not the full experimental product table.

evidence.label: UniProt Q2XSC5: reviewed sequence and experimental function annotation
evidence.text: The pinned 564-residue sequence is reviewed; function and catalytic activity cite experimental evidence from PMID17662687. Some other annotations are by similarity.

evidence.label: Experimental structure coverage in the pinned record
evidence.text: No PDB cross-reference appears in the pinned Q2XSC5 entry. No experimental coordinates or predicted protein model are included for this enzyme.

publications.title: Cloning and functional characterization of three terpene synthases from lavender (Lavandula angustifolia).
publications.access_used: PubMed abstract and reviewed UniProt experimental annotations; primary full text was not inspected.

experimental_structure.availability_evidence: No PDB cross-reference in the pinned reviewed Q2XSC5 record.
experimental_structure.availability_scope: This is a bounded finding from the selected source snapshot, not proof that no experimental structure exists anywhere.
interpretation_limits: No lavender enzyme pocket, catalytic pose, metal geometry or structural comparison is inferred.
No predicted protein structure is substituted for missing experimental coordinates.

annotation_limits: UniProt Mg2+/Mn2+ cofactor and metal-binding annotations use ECO:0000250 (by similarity); they are not direct observations for this selected enzyme.
The DDXXD motif is annotated in UniProt without an explicit evidence item on the motif feature.
No transit-peptide boundary is imposed on this sequence.
